title: Altair: A Record of Battles
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In a fantasy world modeled on the Ottoman Mediterranean, Tugril Mahmut, a war orphan and the youngest pasha of Turkiye's stratocracy, wants above all to prevent war. After an assassination pushes his nation toward conflict with the expansionist Balt-Rhein Empire, he travels to build alliances among neighboring states, leading to a great continental war. A 27-volume epic that won the Kodansha Manga Award.
life_message: Statecraft, alliances and trust between peoples are worth more than conquest, though defending one's homeland can require war.
